1.title: What Is Out There? The Findings So Far of a Trump-Backed U.F.O. Panel.
1.summary: Uncovering evidence of alien life would be “the biggest discovery ever made by humanity,” one expert said. But so far, there’s a lot of blurry photos and unconfirmed reports.

2.title: US jobs market sees sharp slowdown ahead of midterm elections
2.summary: Unemployment rose slightly as American employers paused hiring with midterm elections just a month away.

3.title: Carmel-by-the-Sea Reluctantly Adopts Street Addresses After 110 Years
3.summary: Driven by emergency response needs, Carmel-by-the-Sea reluctantly adopted street address numbers this summer, igniting concerns over its vanishing identity as a beachside village.

4.title: Ukraine Reports First Combat Use of Its Own Ballistic Missile
4.summary: While the missile fired on Thursday has a limited range, Kyiv is developing a larger weapon that could strike Moscow.

5.title: Fighting Intensifies in Yemen, Raising Fears Further of All-Out War
5.summary: Yemen’s capital, Sanaa, was bombarded overnight, after government forces reported some of the most intense clashes in years around Taiz, the country’s third largest city.

6.title: Blockades, Fireworks and Tear Gas: Young Protesters Are Rattling France
6.summary: Days of unrest have affected more than 1,000 schools across France as high school students push for better standards.
